text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, starting the recording now, 
Love-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This time it's a special edition! We're 
actually in a town near Del Mar Racetrack 
in America to watch the Breeders' Cup~♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Is it just my imagination, or are all 
the passersby focusing their gazes on 
us...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Could it be because of my 
inescapable saintly aura...?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It's just that Japanese school uniforms 
stand out in a tourist spot. ...Sheesh, 
you'd think we're on a school trip or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, is the casino guy meeting up at 
the racetrack in the end?
choice_data_list:
Looks like the meeting with the URA is 
dragging on.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And Yan-ko wandered off somewhere too, 
man... Isn't there anyone who knows the 
way to the racetrack--

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I made friends with someone who 
knows this area. She said she'd take me to 
the racetrack☆

text_block_list.name: Cheerful American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I'll also show you some good dessert 
spots. (I'll tell you about some yummy 
dessert spots too~)"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh, really? Can we get frozen yogurt 
then? (For real? Let's go get froyo 
then!)"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Talking about sweets all the 
way out in America? Didn't you come here 
to watch the race...?

And so, in a completely relaxed and casual 
mood, we headed toward Del Mar Racetrack, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious sweets know no borders, do 
they?♪ Every single one was totally 
satisfying♪ For real though, this totally 
has that festival vibe going on, right? 
The atmosphere?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But it feels a bit different from an 
overcrowded venue where you can barely 
move...
choice_data_list:
We've got two days, so maybe the crowd 
will be a bit spread out.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that might be true. It's not like 
every single person who comes is gonna 
watch every single race, after all.

I recall the massive turnout on GⅠ race 
days in Japan. If they were all held at 
once, it's easy to see why it would be 
packed to capacity all day long.

That said, the BC is a massive two-day 
event. Perhaps the peak excitement is 
centered around the marquee event, the BC 
Classic.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they even have regular music 
concerts. Seems different from Umamusume 
Winning Lives.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Though, aren't there quite a few people 
dressed super sharp? Almost like they're 
in formal wear."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Now that you mention it, does feel 
that way, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, for real!? That's so cool! (Wait, 
seriously? That's awesome!)"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
The people dressed in crisp, sharp clothes 
are apparently, like, super high-class 
celebs!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"There seem to be VIPs from the racing 
world among them too. If you catch their 
eye, you might even get scouted~♪"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...? Rather than some stiff, 
grand race, is this actually more of a fun 
event?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Maybe everyone's just running with a 
festival mindset after all.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head over towards the 
stands soon♪
(Wooooooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now it's the final stretch! Who's gonna 
break ahead!? (The final stretch! Who's 
going to break away!?)

—I couldn't even bring myself to utter the 
word “fast.”

text_block_list.name: Race Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Who's gonna take the lead? Who's gonna get 
the glory!? (Who takes the lead? Who 
claims the glory!?)

Despite the world-class blistering pace 
from the start, many Umamusume still 
unleash astonishing late surges.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—A festival mood? Far from it... They're 
dead serious, totally and completely for 
real...!

text_block_list.name: Race Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And we have our winner! What an impressive 
finish! (A winner has been decided! An 
overwhelming victory...!)

—Every single race was a battle pushed 
beyond all limits.

Is it because they stake their entire 
racing careers on chasing the glorious 
"American Dream"?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: What is... this...!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We…… must have watched last year's BC too, 
right……?

—Yes. Even though it was a race I should 
have known, it looked completely different 
from what I saw on the broadcast.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Their push-off and center-of-gravity 
control are on a whole different level. 
...And that goes for pretty much all of 
them, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, does your foot not sink into that 
dirt at all? If that's for real, that's 
gonna totally change how you run...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the battle of the chosen... 
The greatest trial for Saint Red Desire...

text_block_list.name: Cheerful American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Everyone here's expert-level. (Every 
single one of them is an expert.)

text_block_list.name: Cheerful American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"They run with pride, knowing they're the 
world's best. (They're running with the 
pride of being the world's best on the 
line.)"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Good. Cause the same goes for us. (Nice, 
same goes for us too~)

text_block_list.name: Cheerful American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, I thought you might be a racer. When 
are you competing?" (I knew it. When are 
you running?)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Heh, next yearâª (Hehe, next yearâª)

text_block_list.name: Cheerful American Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Really? (Are you sure?)"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I want to race you guys! (I 
want to compete against you all one day 
too!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
――Haha...! That's way nastier than I ever 
imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
And that girl didn't even look surprised. 
I guess she sees this kind of level every 
year.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You look quite tense, Trainer. Did 
something happen before I arrived?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehe. As you have seen, the power 
of the top racing nations' Umamusume is 
truly formidable.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume who gather at the BC are 
true experts. Under their preferred 
conditions, they boast unrivaled 
strength."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
For instance, American Umamusume excel on 
flat dirt tracks—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
She is particularly specialized in 
navigating counter-clockwise turns at top 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...So this is the real deal, the origin 
of the technique I learned from the 
casino...)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Similarly, on turf races, European 
Umamusume truly reign as the experts.
choice_data_list:
The world's strongest under any and all 
conditions, huh...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And regarding the American 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Just outside the city, this country has 
vast expanses of land, and there are 
countless girls who've been gaining 
running experience through play since 
before they can remember."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The geographic characteristics of our 
country are precisely what foster an 
athletic population exceeding twenty 
thousand, you see.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Naturally—if more individuals are blessed 
with opportunities to cultivate the buds 
of their talent early on—
choice_data_list:
...It also affects how many geniuses are 
nurtured.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The countless geniuses born from that 
system reign supreme, wielding 
hyper-specialized techniques as their 
weapons. That is the world of the 
Breeders' Cup.

I took charge of the team and walked this 
path until now. Every single Umamusume 
possesses a rare talent.

"Even so, can you truly say you can make 
me win against the world's strongest 
rivals we saw here today?"

Can I really send everyone on the team, 
send <chrname>, out there telling them they can 
win?

I joined this project because I resonated 
with her passion after she bounced back 
from defeat, and yet...

As the trainer of the team fighting on 
this grand stage next year, my hands were 
trembling.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. Trainer, why the complicated face?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"With your brow furrowed like that... Ah, 
could it be you've got an upset stomach?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...Humph♪ Aaah! I'm so glad I came to 
America~!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: ...don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Just take a look at everyone's faces!☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! A-Agh, what a waste! I could've 
totally won if I'd run this year...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I can't race, then it is what it 
is! Instead... next year's mine for the 
taking!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"When victory is achieved at the BC... the 
path shall open, and the Saintess will 
finally reach 'that sacred land.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That scene will illuminate the entire 
world with the light of hope, and surely 
become a guiding beacon for those who are 
lost.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I will fill the world with "love." First, 
I'll definitely win and make everyone fall 
for me♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"‘Don't worry! This team is super strong! 
We can definitely win, and Love-chan's 
dream will come true too!’"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: How about you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Commentary Audio
text_block_list.text:
"This settles it completely! The leader 
holds a 5-length lead—"

Respect for those formidable rivals 
boasting overwhelming strength turned into 
an "aspiration" within me.

Yet before I knew it, that admiration grew 
too strong, and I built an insurmountable 
wall on my own. I turned them into someone 
I could only ever chase.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: I see. Admiration, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Still... don't you think that while you 
can chase after an idol, you can never 
truly surpass them?"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it feels like all you're doing is 
staring at their back, right? Like you 
can't even look them in the face.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that mean we just don't have 
enough info? Info that we need to catch up 
and overtake them.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I don't pass them, I can't 
become the best in the world."

Yes. I am the Trainer for DREAMS. I am 
here to make them the best in the world.

Win. Win and surpass her. Not just 
admiring her and chasing her back forever. 
Not as an unreachable idol, but as a goal 
to conquer.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that look in your eyes just changed, 
didn't it? Love it☆ A mindset makeover is 
an absolute must for innovation, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...And? Where are you setting your 
ultimate goal? A management policy needs 
to be concrete, you know.
choice_data_list:
A Breeders' Cup victory... We'll win every 
single race we enter!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! We should always aim high, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely lead the team to victory 
and fulfill our long-cherished wish. And 
seize the glory we let slip away that day 
back into my hands!
choice_data_list: Yeah! We'll definitely pull it off!

text_block_list.text:
Winning not by a fluke miracle, but 
through sheer ability to stand alongside 
the world's powerhouses. This was the 
moment the days of true challenge began 
for team DREAMS.
